verdict.rationale: Fireflies ships a built-in AI assistant, AskFred/Fred. Its docs cover natural-language Q&A over single and multiple meetings with conversational context. The 'delegate tasks' element rests only on homepage marketing lines: Fred drafts email replies, sorts the inbox, tracks follow-ups, and suggests next steps in Slack. The action-taking MCP tools serve external agents, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of in-product task execution (not just Q&A), detail on which actions Fred can carry out autonomously, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AskFred is Fireflies' AI-powered meeting assistant that lets you ask natural language questions about your meeting transcripts.
